EdwCustomTableConfig.CreateViewQuery:
CREATE VIEW [InternationalLogistics].[vw_GRP__FCLConsolContainers] WITH SCHEMABINDING
AS
SELECT C.ConsolidationKey AS ConsolKey, C.ConsolidationID AS ConsolPK, SUM(C.ContainerCount) AS ContainerCount, SUM(R.TEU * C.ContainerCount) AS TotalTEU FROM InternationalLogistics.BAS__Container C LEFT JOIN InternationalLogistics.BAS__ReferenceContainer R ON C.ReferenceContainerKey = R.ReferenceContainerKey WHERE C.ConsolidationKey IS NOT NULL GROUP BY C.ConsolidationKey, C.ConsolidationID
